summary: End-to-end smoke test of Sentinel Monitor backend + frontend. All 13 requested flows verified successfully against public URL. Auth (login/me/logout), Dashboard, Servers CRUD + force-check + history, Agent metrics push, Domains SSL+WHOIS check (both resolved), Credentials CRUD, Notes CRUD, Notification settings + Resend test (email_ok=true), Activity feed, and full sidebar navigation (Servers, Domains, Vault, Notes, Alerts) all pass with zero console errors.
passed: POST /api/auth/login with admin@sentinel.app / admin123 -> returns access_token + user
POST /api/servers (check_kind=https, target=https://www.google.com) -> created, appears in GET /api/servers
POST /api/domains (google.com) then POST /api/domains/{id}/check -> ssl.days_remaining=65, whois.days_remaining=722 (both ok)
GET/PUT /api/settings/notifications work; POST /api/settings/notifications/test -> email_ok:true, webhook_ok:false (as expected, webhook disabled)
Frontend login flow via UI (data-testid selectors) succeeds and redirects to /
Sidebar navigation to /servers, /domains, /vault, /notes, /settings all render without console errors

warnings.issue: Review request referenced field 'type' for POST /api/servers, but the actual ServerIn schema uses 'check_kind'. Similarly AgentMetricsIn uses 'server_id' + 'cpu_percent/mem_percent/disk_percent' + uptime:str (not 'cpu/memory/disk' + uptime:int). Tests were adjusted to use actual schema and all passed. No code fix needed.
